title: The Iliad: Immortals
description: The gods who take sides in the war.

pairs.q: *Immortal.* Son of Kronos, father of gods and men, who grants Thetis' prayer to honor her son.
*Immortal.* Queen of the gods, wife and sister of Zeus, who hates Troy; she lulls her husband to sleep on Ida.
*Immortal.* The grey-eyed daughter of Zeus, who grabs Achilleus by the hair to stop him from drawing his sword on Agamemnon.
*Immortal.* Phoibos the archer, whose arrows bring the plague; he strikes Patroklos from behind.
*Immortal.* Goddess of love and mother of Aineias; Diomedes wounds her in the hand.
*Immortal.* The god of war, who fights for the Trojans; Athene knocks him down with a boundary stone.
*Immortal.* The earth-shaker, brother of Zeus and lord of the sea, who rallies the Achaians while Zeus sleeps.
*Immortal.* A sea-goddess and mother of Achilleus, who asks Zeus to give the Trojans the upper hand.
*Immortal.* Argeïphontes, the guide who escorts Priam through the Achaian camp at night.
*Immortal.* The female messenger of the gods.
*Immortal.* The huntress, Apollo's sister; Hera boxes her ears with her own bow.
